mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_take_number, status, note, opened_at, opened_by, closed_at, closed_by, surplus_receipt_id, created_at, updated_at FROM warehouse.stock_takes WHERE id = #{id}

choose.when: closed_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC
note DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC

where.if: AND ( LOWER(stock_take_number) LIKE LOWER(#{searchLike}) OR LOWER(note) LIKE LOWER(#{searchLike}) )

mapper.select:
SELECT stock_take_number AS stockTakeNumber, id AS id, status AS status, note AS note, opened_at AS openedAt, closed_at AS closedAt FROM warehouse.stock_takes
ORDER BY LIMIT #{params.pageSize} OFFSET #{params.offset}
SELECT id FROM warehouse.stock_takes WHERE status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse.stock_take_items (stock_take_id, product_id, expected_quantity, surplus_unit_price) SELECT #{stockTakeId}, p.id, p.quantity_on_hand, last_batch.unit_price_excl_vat FROM warehouse.products p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT gri.unit_price_excl_vat FROM warehouse.goods_receipt_items gri WHERE gri.product_id = p.id ORDER BY gri.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_batch ON TRUE WHERE p.is_active = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse.stock_take_items sti SET closed_expected_quantity = p.quantity_on_hand, closed_difference = sti.counted_quantity - p.quantity_on_hand FROM warehouse.products p WHERE p.id = sti.product_id AND sti.stock_take_id = #{stockTakeId} AND sti.counted_quantity IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT sti.id AS id, p.id AS productId, p.sku AS sku, p.name AS name, p.unit AS unit, sti.expected_quantity AS expectedQuantity, COALESCE(sti.closed_expected_quantity, p.quantity_on_hand) AS currentQuantity, sti.counted_quantity AS countedQuantity, CASE WHEN sti.closed_difference IS NOT NULL THEN sti.closed_difference WHEN sti.counted_quantity IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE sti.counted_quantity - p.quantity_on_hand END AS difference, sti.surplus_unit_price AS surplusUnitPrice FROM warehouse.stock_take_items sti JOIN warehouse.products p ON p.id = sti.product_id WHERE sti.stock_take_id = #{stockTakeId} ORDER BY p.name

SELECT gri.id AS id, gri.goods_receipt_id AS goodsReceiptId, gri.product_id AS productId, gri.name_snapshot AS nameSnapshot, gri.quantity_received AS quantityReceived, gri.quantity_remaining AS quantityRemaining, gri.unit_price_excl_vat AS unitPriceExclVat, gri.vat_rate AS vatRate FROM warehouse.goods_receipt_items gri JOIN warehouse.goods_receipts gr ON gr.id = gri.goods_receipt_id WHERE gri.product_id = #{productId} AND gri.quantity_remaining > 0 ORDER BY gr.issue_date ASC NULLS LAST, gri.id ASC FOR UPDATE OF gri
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse.stock_takes SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = NOW(), closed_by = #{userId}, surplus_receipt_id = #{surplusReceiptId}, note = COALESCE(#{note}, note) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
